Initialize and register stamp aliases for PIP folders

init_pip_aliases.Rd

Sets up short, human-friendly aliases for each of the repository folders returned by set_pip_folders() using the stamp package. When include_release = TRUE, release-specific aliases will include the release string (so aliases like pip_meta_20251211 are created).

Usage

init_pip_aliases(
  folder_paths,
  verbose = getOption("pipfun.verbose"),
  include_release = FALSE,
  release = NULL
)

Arguments

folder_paths

named list: output of set_pip_folders().

verbose

logical: whether to print alias registration messages.

include_release

logical: when TRUE, append _<release> to aliases for folders that are release-specific.

release

character|null: release identifier used when include_release = TRUE. Required in that case.

Value

Invisibly returns a named character vector of the final alias names. The vector's names correspond to the keys of folder_paths.
